task.description: Implement containment-spec.md and T5 tests through reusable lib/contained-read seam; permit internal links, refuse external/owner-root replacement and descriptor identity races. Reuse/extract SAC descriptor primitives without forbidden cross-module dependency or weakening SAC no-follow semantics. Integrate MCP resource listing/read and harness wiki/skills discovery/read; bounded cycles, file types and byte limits. Preserve safe typed errors and explicit unsupported platform refusal. Read typed T6-input.json.
acceptance_criteria: Ordinary file and internal link chain return same bytes inside narrow owner root.
External/sibling/root-replacement links and nonfiles/unreadable paths cannot disclose synthetic sentinel or unsafe target names.
MCP resource listing and harness wiki/skills discovery/direct reads observe the same containment rules; cycles are bounded.
Race test verifies descriptor/identity protection or explicit capability refusal; no unsupported full TOCTOU claim.
task.module_patterns: Narrow owner-root descriptor-chain containment with typed safe failures; preserve SAC nofollow policy; supported symlinks internal only.
